tools.name: session_capabilities
tools.description: Discover the caller host's runtimes and configuration catalogs for a same-hat cwd. With Delegation on, every listed model, mode and option is allowed. Unknown or stale catalogs are reported honestly.

inputSchema.title: CapabilitiesArgs
inputSchema.description: Caller-host capabilities, scoped to the caller's hat and validated cwd.

tools.name: session_spawn
tools.description: Spawn one direct child in a selected runtime. With Delegation on, you may pick any model, mode and option in the child runtime's catalog (session_capabilities), including modes that don't ask for permission (Claude bypassPermissions, Codex agent-full-access). If mode is omitted, inherit the parent's mode for the same runtime, or map installed Claude bypassPermissions to Codex agent-full-access (and vice versa) across runtimes when offered; otherwise use the runtime default. No provider or model substitute is used. The brief waits for confirmed configuration. Permission requests raised by a child go to the operator; the parent cannot answer them. Children cannot spawn grandchildren. Mutations use a durable operation_key scoped to this caller session across tool names, including token rotation. Retry the same canonical typed request with the same key to retrieve its receipt; changed requests return operation_conflict. Delivery is not completion.

inputSchema.title: SpawnArgs
inputSchema.description: Start one independently configured direct child, without provider fallback.

ConfigFields.description: Object-only strict decoding/schema adapter for the shared session config.

ConfigValue.description:
The value of one config option (ACP `session/set_config_option`): a
select's value id, or a boolean toggle's state.

tools.name: session_send
tools.description: Queue bounded follow-up text for a direct child. A genuinely parked child may resume after fresh configuration evidence; a closed child never reopens. Mutations use a durable operation_key scoped to this caller session across tool names, including token rotation. Retry the same canonical typed request with the same key to retrieve its receipt; changed requests return operation_conflict. Delivery is not completion.

inputSchema.title: SendArgs
inputSchema.description: Queue an ordinary follow-up for an owned direct child.

tools.name: session_answer
tools.description: Answer ordinary elicitation only using its pending_id. For action accept, content must be a JSON object matching the child's requestedSchema, embedded in the question delivery and session_status. Example: requestedSchema={"type":"object","properties":{"question_0":{"type":"string","enum":["blue","green"]}},"required":["question_0"]} requires content={"question_0":"blue"}. Use the actual schema's property names and values, not this example's. Omit content for decline/cancel. Invalid content returns invalid_arguments as a tool error; correct the content and retry. Permission requests raised by a child go to the operator; the parent cannot answer them (operator_required). Escalate missing facts and product decisions to the operator. Mutations use a durable operation_key scoped to this caller session across tool names, including token rotation. Retry the same canonical typed request with the same key to retrieve its receipt; changed requests return operation_conflict. Delivery is not completion.

inputSchema.title: AnswerArgs
inputSchema.description:
Answer ordinary elicitation only. Permission requests raised by a child
go to the operator; the parent cannot answer them.

content.description: For accept, an object matching the child's requestedSchema. Omit for decline/cancel.

ElicitationAction.description: The operator's answer to an elicitation (ACP `elicitation/create`).

tools.name: session_status
tools.description: Read one owned direct child's lifecycle, configuration, questions, reports and operation receipts. Permission requests raised by a child go to the operator; the parent cannot answer them and receives no answerable schema for them.

inputSchema.title: StatusArgs
inputSchema.description: Read a direct child's state, optionally selecting one operation receipt.

tools.name: session_list
tools.description: Page only the caller's direct children with shared work observations, bounded last-response excerpts, waiting and queue counts, and advisory plans. Missing background telemetry does not establish completion. Follow next_cursor; no owner-wide or recursive enumeration.

inputSchema.title: ListArgs
inputSchema.description: Page direct children only, never owner-wide sessions or grandchildren.

tools.name: session_close
tools.description: Close one direct child and cancel its unstarted follow-ups. Does not delete files, cascade or delete sessions. Mutations use a durable operation_key scoped to this caller session across tool names, including token rotation. Retry the same canonical typed request with the same key to retrieve its receipt; changed requests return operation_conflict. Delivery is not completion.

inputSchema.title: CloseArgs
inputSchema.description: Close one direct child. Does not delete sessions or clean files.
